NEMA names Anguwan bayan Tudu in Barkin Ladi LGA. The Barkin Ladi seat is used as a broad spatial-neighbourhood anchor pending a verified community point; not an exact inundation point.

NEMA lists Bekaji Jambutu Bachure and Jimeta-area impacts. A published flood-risk study defines Greater Yola centre at 9°13′48″N 12°27′36″E; used as a spatial-neighbourhood anchor only.
